title: 02 - Energy & Cost
description: ¿Dónde se está consumiendo energía? Consumo y potencia observados. El coste requiere una tarifa explícita y no se estima.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT count(DISTINCT entity_id) AS value FROM tfm.silver.matter_events WHERE device_class = 'energy' AND unit = 'kWh'
SELECT CAST(sum(grid_consumption_kwh) AS DOUBLE) AS value FROM tfm.gold.grid_energy_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(observation_date)

WITH latest AS (SELECT entity_id, numeric_state, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY entity_id ORDER BY event_time DESC, bronze_timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM tfm.silver.matter_events WHERE device_class = 'power' AND unit = 'W' AND numeric_state IS NOT NULL) SELECT CAST(sum(numeric_state) AS DOUBLE) AS value FROM latest WHERE rn = 1

options.content: Hay telemetría de **kWh** y **W**, pero no una tarifa eléctrica versionada. Para evitar estimaciones engañosas, no se convierte consumo a euros.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT event_time AS time, replace(coalesce(friendly_name, entity_id), '[SYN] ', '') AS metric, CAST(numeric_state AS DOUBLE) AS value FROM tfm.silver.matter_events WHERE device_class = 'power' AND unit = 'W' AND numeric_state IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT observation_date AS fecha, round(grid_consumption_kwh, 3) AS consumo_kwh, round(surplus_energy_kwh, 3) AS excedentes_kwh, round(generation_energy_kwh, 3) AS generacion_kwh, supply_count AS suministros, loaded_at AS ultima_carga FROM tfm.gold.grid_energy_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(observation_date) ORDER BY fecha DESC
